patterns: 4K AI cinema claim went mega-viral: EHuanglu's 'crazy now AI can make 4k movies' hit 1.25M views / 4.7K likes / 1.5K bookmarks, ~12x the next post. Day 2 of the 'AI is ready for cinema' meta (after his 16.5K on 19.11). Formula: one-line awe claim + raw 4K clip, no tool talk.

Gemini 4 Neon launch wave: minchoi's '10 examples' roundup 102K / 441 bookmarks + 'Google cooked' 16.8K; outsiders' same-prompt model comparisons (Gemini 4 Neon vs GPT-6.2 vs Opus 5.5, 56K) ride the same news.
Tutorials earn saves: techhalla's Magnific full lipsynced music video tutorial 15K / 287 bookmarks (bookmarks > likes), plus a one-prompt Magnific Illusion background swap.
'10 wild examples' listicle threads keep working for minchoi (game dev by prompting 17.5K) - curation format, off-niche but repeatable.
Seedance 2.5 everywhere: EHuanglu's fable 5.2 + Seedance 2.5 (6K), azed_ai's 30s Seedance 2.5 4K horror short (2.7K), outsider omidaziz's handwriting test across video models (28K).

AI can now make 4K VFX shots.

No studio. No render farm. Just me in Marseille.

This is what one afternoon looks like now 👇
drafts.video_tip: Lead with your single best 4K hero shot, full-frame, 8-10s, no text overlay for the first 2s; mirror EHuanglu's one-line awe format. Only claim the tools and time you actually used.

How I build a full VFX shot with AI, step by step.
